quotes.text: output should end with closing HTML tag

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The HTML display emitter writes closing body/html tags in EndAllAttachments rather than EndBody, retaining the filter-sniffer exception. EndBody still notifies body completion before attachment output finishes. The normal non-null attachment-list path calls end-all even when its per-attachment loop is empty. Added regression assertions check the exact output suffix, including a message without attachments; this is static source/test evidence, not an executed conversion or a guarantee for every failure path.
title: MIME HTML closes after attachment output rather than body completion
